description: tools/ holds manual developer utilities (the screenshot pipeline) that ship with no release. Bumping their deps would still drag a release:* label onto the PR and version the whole product, so they are left alone.

packageRules.description: Non-breaking updates auto-merge once CI passes; major bumps always wait for manual review.
Every PR needs a release:* label before it can merge (see require-release-label.yml) — map Renovate's own semver classification onto ours.
